# pass (ExportFunctions.java) recognises, read by that pass at run time and by the Python read
# side (lib/pattern/extractor_names.py). Part of the extraction fingerprint (pass_version): any
# edit here re-extracts every binary on the next scan.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. The first other line is the
# header and must match exactly. A row has at most as many cells as the header; trailing empty
# cells may be omitted. Index columns are 0-based argument positions; an empty cell means "not
# sink_cmd   command sink; key_idx = the command argument                 key_idx
# sink_fmt   format-string sink; key_idx = the format argument            key_idx
# writer     fills a destination buffer (a stack_buf writer)              -
# writer_fmt printf-family buffer writer; fmt_idx = its format argument  fmt_idx
# nvram      nvram accessor; op = read/write/commit/getall                op (+ key_idx for read/write)
# tokenizer  splits a string into tokens                                  -
# forward_cmd shell-running sink whose first argument IS the command     -
# nvram columns: key_idx = the key argument (-1 for whole-store ops); name_idx = the name half of a
# composite prefix+name key (-1 otherwise); val_idx = the written value (-1 for reads and key-only
# writes); returns_value = true when a read returns the stored VALUE (a value source), false when
# it returns a predicate about it; empty for write/commit/getall.
